Timeline/1997
1997Journal article

Sequence learning

Long Short-Term Memory

Memory cells and gates addressed difficulties in learning long-range dependencies.

Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber

AI topics

Explore related entries. Larger tags appear on more entries.

MemoryRecurrent networksSequence learningTraining methods

The contribution

LSTM introduced a recurrent architecture designed to preserve useful error signals over long intervals. Its memory mechanism and gates provided a way to learn which information to retain and when to use it in sequence tasks.

What this does not establish

LSTM mitigates particular learning difficulties; it does not guarantee perfect recall or unlimited reasoning over long sequences.

Why this date?

The original journal paper appeared in November 1997.
